title: Mari sambut Tuhan Yesus
credits: Terj.Ind.: Pdt Toga PL Rajagukguk BSM

rows: Ma-ri sam-but Tu-han Ye-sus Di s da-tang pa-da-mu Di-a me-nge-tuk ha-ti-mu Ye-sus me-nan-ti-kan-mu Ma-ri sam-but Tu-han Ye-sus di-am da-lam ha-ti-mu Ki-ni wak-tu pe-nga-si-han ja-ngan sam-pai ber-la-lu
